## Description

Allocates capital across asset classes inversely proportional to their downside semivariance and expected shortfall contributions rather than symmetric total variance.

## Where it may fit

Portfolios exposed to fat-tailed asset classes, asymmetric drawdown risk environments, multi-asset allocation.

## Vehicles

Risk-parity funds, institutional pension portfolios, wealth management allocators.

## Required data

Historical return series, tail probability thresholds, downside semi-deviation metrics.

## Caveats

Requires robust historical sample lengths to reliably estimate tail risk metrics without estimation noise.
